title: INMP441 I²S mic
_note: The round breakout board has 2 rows of 3 pins, 7.62 mm (3 holes) apart: GND, VDD, SD in one row and L/R, WS, SCK in the other. Thus it goes across the center gap, like a chip.

datasheet.summary: A digital microphone. It sends sound as I²S data, so the board reads numbers, not a voltage.
datasheet.supply: 1.8 V to 3.3 V on VDD. Do not connect it to 5 V.

pins.GND: Ground. Connect it to the ground of the board.
pins.SD: Serial data out. The sound samples go from the mic to the board on this pin.
pins.LR: Left or right channel. Connect it to ground for the left channel, or to VDD for the right channel.
pins.WS: Word select (frame clock). The board tells the mic when each sample starts.
pins.SCK: Serial clock (bit clock). The board sets the speed of the data.
